science.explanation: The Molecular Cornucopia Unit is a novel device that leverages nanotechnology to create a self-sustaining ecosystem for molecular interactions.
assumptions: Molecular recognition and binding can be engineered at the nanoscale.
A stable energy source can be integrated into the device.

diagrams.mermaid: graph LR; A[Device] -->|Energy Source|> B[Nanostructures]; C[Molecules] -->|Binding|> D[Complex];
diagrams.caption: Schematic of the Molecular Cornucopia Unit

citations.title: Nanotechnology for molecular recognition and binding
citations.snippet: We demonstrate the use of nanotechnology to engineer molecular recognition and binding at the nanoscale.

citations.title: Energy harvesting for self-sustaining devices
citations.snippet: We present a novel energy harvesting mechanism for self-sustaining devices, enabling long-term operation without external power sources.

citations.title: Molecular cornucopia: A new paradigm for molecular interactions
citations.snippet: We introduce the concept of a molecular cornucopia, where multiple molecules interact and influence each other in a self-sustaining ecosystem.
